projects.descriptor: Multi-tenant campaign platform for Argentine food and consumer-goods distributors: schedule promo blasts to thousands of retail buyers, route the replies, and keep each tenant's contacts and templates separate.

Grain and oilseed brokerage: match Argentine sellers with buyers worldwide, draft the contracts, and follow shipment and collection across hundreds of concurrent deals so the urgent ones surface before they slip.
Administration for a home-visit music school: assign instructors to lessons at each student's home, bill per class, and reconcile monthly payments and instructor pay.
Rebuild of a client's ageing in-house business system, porting the existing rules onto a maintained codebase; scope still awaiting the client's answers.
Course teaching practising lawyers to use AI in day-to-day legal work: curriculum, exercises, and the working hypothesis of what a lawyer actually changes in their week.
Archived client engagement; no active domain or scope on record.
Video surveillance for security operators: watch many live camera feeds at once and automatically flag the events a person would otherwise have to catch by staring at every stream.
Patient acquisition and follow-up for an eye-surgery practice: turn inbound enquiries into booked consultations and keep post-operative contact, so leads do not go cold in the inbox.
Retired take-home exercise: a short AI-produced video advertisement for a sobriety app, made as a content-engineering job application.
Trading indicators for a discretionary chart trader, with alert-to-execution automation as the later goal — the client's own edge, not a product for sale.
Client sales-operations work centred on measuring which calls actually reach a prospect; early scope.
Moneyless barter marketplace: people post what they have and what they want, and the exchange is matched without currency, including multi-item swaps.
